Alex (CS): Heads up — onboarding queue for ~12 EMEA trial tenants is stalled due to a VPC auth sync failure after a deploy. Some are in renewal window. Priya, can you own comms and renewal outreach?
Priya (CS Ops): Yep. I'll get a list and draft. Which tenants hit first? Need an exec summary for renewals. :point_up:
Jamal (Eng): Root cause: regressed token validation after 2026-03-21 03:22UTC deploy. Seeing 401s from auth-sync-service. Example log: ```ERROR auth-sync sync_failed tenant=acme-uk err="invalid_kid"``` Rolling back to previous image now. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for auth-sync-service (deploy id: dpt-9943).
Sophie (CS Lead): Thank you. I've proactively scheduled an office hours slot tomorrow 11:00 PST for impacted trial admins, and flagged top-3 renewal accounts to prioritize. Draft message for affected tenants below — please review: "We experienced an authentication sync issue affecting onboarding flows for some tenants. Engineering is rolling back the change and we expect normal onboarding to resume shortly. We apologize for the disruption. As a gesture we will apply a service credit and offer a 1:1 onboarding session. Please join office hours here: https://meet.link/office-hours and optionally reply to this thread for tailored help."
Alex (CS): Looks good. Priya, please send tailored notes to the renewal contacts with the credit wording and invite execs to the office hours. Also capture any churn-risk feedback in this form: https://forms.redwood/cs-feedback
Priya (CS Ops): Will do. I'll use the account list from Jamal's trace and include mitigation steps + contact. I'll also request a short RCA email template for affected accounts from Eng once rollback completes.
Jamal (Eng): Rollback complete at 03:31UTC, auth-sync errors dropping in telemetry. Still seeing elevated 401s for a short tail; we'll monitor for 60m. Will post postmortem draft in #postmortems once investigated.
Alex (CS): Great. Action items: 1) Priya send customer comms + credit (ASAP). 2) Sophie run office hours and capture notes. 3) Jamal provide RCA <24h. 4) Alex prepare exec brief for top renewal ops. :calendar:
Sophie (CS Lead): Acknowledged — I'll add a short CS-led note template for renewals.
Priya (CS Ops): Sent first batch to 5 critical tenants with credit offer and office hours link. Copy of note: "We're sorry — issue identified and rolled back; monitoring; issuing credit; join office hours."
Alex (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the execs and customer success tracker. We'll follow up with a formal RCA and credit application confirmation.
